title: chat-server MemoryBackend: ChatContact/query ignores blocked/presence filters
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §ChatContact/query: 'Filter properties: blocked (Boolean), presence (String), identity (String; ...)'. MemoryBackend::query_objects (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs) applies only the identity filter for ChatContact (added by JMAP-405z.3); blocked and presence are silently ignored, so a filtered query returns every contact. query_changes also ignores filter for all types. Pre-existing; found while working JMAP-405z.3.
notes: Folded into JMAP-v9py.15 (Layer E: Implement draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00) by the 2026-10-19 spec gap audit.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (already_fixed, skeptic-confirmed): crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:4728 `"ChatContact" => flag_eq("blocked") && eq("presence") && eq("identity")`. query_changes now passes the filter through: memory.rs:870-885 `QueryParams::new().filter(filter).sort(sort)`. | check: memory.rs:4735 condition_matches has ChatContact => flag_eq("blocked") && eq("presence") && eq("identity"). query_objects (memory.rs ~750-762) applies filter_matches to every type, and filter_matches recurses into FilterOperators before reaching condition_matches. query_changes (memory.rs ~870-885)
